title: Special Executive Programme In International Business Management
description: The course aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of international business management by focusing on global business environments, strategic decision-making, and operations management across borders.
longDescription: This course delves into the internationalisation of business, exploring various global environments, trade policies, and regional trading blocs. Students will examine key strategic approaches to global competitiveness, business operations, supply chain management, and financial risks. Ethical issues, negotiation strategies, and organisational structures will also be addressed, equipping learners to navigate international business challenges.
courseDetails: General agreement on tariffs and trade. Principles of General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade. World trade organisation. Global Competitiveness Models of International Business. Regional Trading Blocs. Major Trade Blocs - ASEAN, EU, MERCOSUR, NAFTA. Standardisation Vs Differentiation. Types of International Strategy. Global Portfolio Management. Modes of global portfolio management. Modes of Entry. International Business Operations. Factors Impacting Production. Make or Buy Decisions. Supply Chain Issues. Global Supply Chain Optimisation. Global Marketing Mix. Financing In International Business. Foreign Exchange Risks. Conflict Management. International Negotiations. Ethical Issues In International Business. Organisational Structures in international business Centralisation Vs. Decentralisation. Subsidiary board of directors. Performance Management. Control mechanisms - Approaches and constraints. Performance Evaluation System. HRM issues. Managing expatriates. This course covers the international business landscape, including trade agreements, global competitiveness, and strategic decision-making in various international markets. Emphasis is placed on business operations, ethical challenges, and managing expatriates and organisational performance within multinational companies. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; International Business Environment: Managing International Trade: Strategic Approach To International Business: International Business Operations: Organisational Structures In International Business:

modules.title: International Business Management
modules.summary: International Business Management equips students with the knowledge to navigate the complexities of global business operations. Students will evaluate business environments through case studies and real-world examples, learn global marketing and supply chain strategies, and manage international trade agreements. The course also covers decision-making in foreign market entry, negotiation tactics, and managing international workforce dynamics.

outcomes: Analysing the business environment of the host country.
